title: Reduced 9-Layer Cr-Dielectric Stack with QWOT Initialization
scientific_hypothesis: Reducing layer count from 11 to 9 while enforcing QWOT-based Cr initialization and 300 nm thickness bounds will improve optimizer convergence by reducing search space dimensionality, potentially achieving comparable or better spectral selectivity with simpler manufacturable structure.
design_principle: Fewer interference degrees of freedom with better-initialized absorbing layers may converge faster and avoid local minima that trapped the 11-layer optimization.
proposed_topology: Air | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | Al substrate (9 finite layers total: 3 Cr, 3 HfO2, 3 SiO2)
design_variables: all 9 layer thicknesses with 300 nm upper bound
Cr layers initialized at QWOT for 550 nm central wavelength
manufacturing_considerations: 300 nm bound prevents excessively thick layers
QWOT initialization provides physically meaningful starting point
theory_basis: Admittance locus method for metal-dielectric multilayers
QWOT initialization reduces optimizer search space
Fewer layers may improve convergence if physics supports simpler interference
expected_advantages: Faster convergence due to reduced dimensionality
Better initialization avoids poor local minima
More manufacturable with fewer deposition steps
known_risks: May lack sufficient interference degrees of freedom for target spectral shape
9-layer topology may be fundamentally limited compared to 11-layer
execution_request_english: Optimize a 9-layer planar multilayer stack on aluminum substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 (9 finite layers). All layer thicknesses bounded 10-300 nm. Initialize Cr layers at quarter-wave optical thickness for 550 nm central wavelength using Cr refractive index at that wavelength. Initialize dielectric layers at 80-120 nm. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with gradient clipping for first 50 steps. Evaluate absorptance in 400-700 nm band and reflectance in 700-2000 nm band at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Total layer count fixed at 9. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 700-2000 nm. soft objectives: high absorptance in 400-700 nm; low reflectance in 400-700 nm; high reflectance in 700-2000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance in 400-700 nm; high absorptance in 700-2000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 20.
revision_reason: Reduced from 11 to 9 layers per feedback to test if simpler topology with better initialization outperforms previous 11-layer results; avoids all tested 11L fingerprints from route_03
